FaultType.description: The kind of contract failure detected on a partition.
FaultType.title: FaultType

description:
The label MERIDIAN-Bench will score detections against.

The id is a UUID5 of the injection inputs, so the same inputs rebuild the
same label.

arrival_delay_s.description: Seconds past the freshness deadline. Set only for a late partition.
arrival_delay_s.title: Arrival Delay S

causal_event_id.description: The one change event that caused this fault. It must be in events.jsonl.
causal_event_id.title: Causal Event Id

columns_affected.description: Columns the injector changed. Empty when only metadata moved.
columns_affected.title: Columns Affected

dataset.description: Dataset the fault was applied to.
dataset.title: Dataset

intensity.description: Strength of the injection, from just above 0 through 1.
intensity.title: Intensity

rows_affected.description: How many rows the injector changed.
rows_affected.title: Rows Affected

seed.description: Seed used to build the corrupted frame.
seed.title: Seed

title: InjectedFault
